purpose: A source-cited proposal for executable rule data; not a runtime graph and not Call of Cthulhu rules.

ruleLanguage.randomness: Each D6 result persists its raw face in a counter; table outcomes are explicit indexed choices. Attack dice explosion is represented only after its source-scope conflict is resolved.

procedure: roll d6 plus only the modifiers stated by the applicable rule
natural 1 is failure
natural 6 is success
rules.review: The book summary states natural 1/6 always fail/succeed; some specialized rules preserve an unmodified 1.

procedure: on natural 6 roll and add another d6; continue while each new natural die is 6
rules.review: Scope conflict: detailed rule p.31 specifically describes Attack dice; overview p.102 says any d6 roll except table rolls. Preserve as unresolved until rule review.

procedure: set Life=8 and Sanity=8
allocate 3 additional points between Life and Sanity
choose 2 non-arcane Skills
roll/select starting weapon and starting items per source tables
start with 1 knife; reroll duplicate item results
rules.review: The overview summary differs in its wording for item selection; reconcile with pages 8-10 before runtime.

procedure: complete current mission and grant listed mission reward
restore Life and Sanity to current maxima
retain XP, equipment, skills, injuries, mental scars, and campaign progress
if 7 Hell Gates are closed, end campaign in victory; otherwise continue the same surviving character
rules.review: A mission ends after completing its goal and returning Home; the campaign spans multiple missions.

procedure: increment mission box counter and record the box on the town map
do not roll content for the first box
otherwise roll 2d6 on Town Exploration Table, then resolve the referenced location table
resolve any encounter before Search is offered
rules.review: The town map has 30 boxes per sheet; attach another sheet when needed. Box adjacency constrains movement.

procedure: do not roll Town Exploration again
roll 1-in-6 for Random Encounter unless this is a Safe House
if a fled creature occupies the box, require the applicable Stealth roll
consume 1 Food
if Food is unavailable, lose 1 Life
apply Resistant to Hunger adjustment: every 6 boxes basic, every 7 boxes Expert
rules.review: Track crossings, not just unique locations. Character death may interrupt the campaign.

rules.trigger: after encounter resolved or empty new box
procedure: offer at most one Search per box per mission
do not offer Search in a Safe House or after fleeing
roll d6 on Search Table, apply Investigator bonus except a natural 1 remains 1
resolve result and persist searchedBoxes
roll the relevant d6 chance
on encounter roll twice on Random Encounter Table and resolve the matching monster table
reroll unique enemies already defeated; if all entries in that unique category are defeated treat as no encounter
rules.review: Several event rules modify or replace this flow; preserve their scoped precedence.

procedure: roll the creature's stated chance of surprise if present
unless surprised, player takes first combat turn
apply Danger Sense by reducing the surprise chance
roll d6 and add applicable weapon and Skill modifiers
natural 1 always fails
damageUnits=floor(modifiedTotal/targetLevel)
damage=damageUnits*weaponDamagePerHit
apply damage to target Life; for one-Life groups each damage point removes one creature
only survivors get an attack opportunity
rules.review: The detailed text defines division by target L; overview summarizes repeated damage for each L surpassed. Confirm special weapons and group allocation against p.20 and p.99.

procedure: roll d6 plus applicable defense Skill modifiers
success when total is equal to or greater than attacker L
on failure apply attacker damage and listed secondary effects
on a natural 1 resolve the additional Defense-roll rule
rules.review: Explicitly equal-or-greater, per the book's note distinguishing it from Four Against Darkness.

procedure: roll a second d6
if the second result is 1, choose one: take 1 additional damage, skip next attack, or destroy main weapon if armed
roll d6 + Slippery modifier versus opponent L
on failure take opponent damage and effects; may try again next turn
on success move to a neighboring previously visited box
unless destination is Safe House, roll 1-in-6 Random Encounter
leave opponents in original box; a later failed Stealth encounter raises their L by 1
rules.review: Slow enemies permit automatic escape unless a specific encounter forbids it; some encounters forbid escape altogether.

procedure: allow player to prevent one attack/event's Life loss by rolling once on Injury Table
each lasting injury use counts toward lifetime cap of 3
at 3 injuries, no further injury roll; Life reaching 0 ends character/game
between missions restore Life to maximum; keep injuries
rules.review: P.33 says negate all damage from a single attack; p.10 summarizes preventing 1 or 2 Life. Review exact scope before execution.

procedure: allow player to prevent 1 or 2 Sanity loss by rolling once on Insanity Table
each result is permanent and counts toward lifetime cap of 3
at 3 scars, accept Sanity loss; Sanity reaching 0 ends character/game
between missions restore Sanity to maximum; keep scars
rules.review: Loss prevention amount depends on the triggering rule; do not force a roll or apply it to all losses.

procedure: base carry limit 10 items plus items held in hands
backpack adds 5 item capacity and 5 Food capacity
Strong adds 3 capacity; Strong Expert adds 5; negligible-weight items excluded
if backpack is lost, discard all carried objects except those in hands
require learned Arcane Skill and its prerequisites/components
spend listed sacrifices at the end of use even if roll fails
perform only the stated Magic/Will check and apply skill modifiers
persist duration, uses, and mission scope from each ritual
rules.review: Arcane Skills are learned during play, not chosen as starting Skills; each ritual has specific requirements and duration.

procedure: grant the mission's explicit listed reward
end mission
retain surviving character for next mission
rules.review: Mission rewards and the 7-gate campaign objective are separate progress layers.

unresolvedSourceQuestions.question: Is explosion limited to Attack rolls, or every non-table d6 as the overview states?
Does the injury roll prevent 1-2 points by player choice or all Life loss from a single attack?
PDF metadata says Escape from Demon City; cover/title and contents say Alone Against Fear.

runtimeCandidateProposal.characterSetup: guided creation; source character sheet values assigned by initialization program, never CoC 3D6/check rules
runtimeCandidateProposal.map: typed town-map state with 30 boxes per sheet, adjacency, visited/searched flags, and explicit exploration-table outcome records; do not encode map as arbitrary story links
runtimeCandidateProposal.combat: typed encounter/turn/action states; D6 attacks/defenses and source-specific L/damage calculations via safe rollEffects/calc/choices; no D100 checks
runtimeCandidateProposal.mission: explicit mission objective, location table refs, rewards, home-return transition and persistent campaign state; random-table results are data tables, not prose-node roulette
